title: Transfer record
description: One attempt to carry a move from a source system to a problem, and what it did there. The entry set records systems that reached a working configuration; this records what happened when a move was actually ported. Mirrors the stdlib validator in src/rosetta_shape_core/transfer.py.

from_entry.description: Entry the move came from. Must resolve. Absent means the source system is unrecorded — a pointer to an entry nobody has written.

from_source.description: Source system, when no entry covers it. One of from_entry / from_source is required.

licensing.description: The grade read at the time. Omit when nobody computed one — an invented grade would make the criterion look tested when it was not.

broke_at.description: Where it stopped working. Required unless the outcome is HELD.

confirms_stop.description: Stop id in from_entry that this transfer actually hit, turning it from asserted into measured.

produced_past.description: Stop id in from_entry that this transfer produced straight past. The stop is contested.

verdict_on.description: What the outcome indicts. HELD admits NONE or SOURCE_READING — a move can port while the account of the source is later corrected.
